request.query: awaytravel.com company profile: industry, number of employees, countries it sells to, website languages, how its team works (remote, hybrid, or office), and whether it is hiring
request.systemPrompt: Research the company that owns the website awaytravel.com. Prefer the company's own site (about, careers, help, store) and reputable business sources. Report facts only. If a fact cannot be determined, use "unknown" for strings, 0 for numbers, false for booleans, and an empty list for arrays. Never guess.
additionalQueries: awaytravel.com careers: open roles, remote or hybrid or in-office work, office locations
awaytravel.com about us: company size, headquarters, and countries or markets served
awaytravel.com online store e-commerce platform and tech stack

highlights.query: company size, markets served, remote or office work, open roles, online store platform

employee_count.description: Approximate total number of employees; 0 if unknown

sells_to.description: Who the company primarily sells to

online_store_platform.description: E-commerce platform behind its online store (e.g. 'Shopify'); 'none' if it does not sell online; 'unknown' if it cannot be determined

countries_served.description: Countries or regions it sells or ships to, one per item. If it serves many, list its largest markets, or a count such as '150+ countries'

website_languages.description: Languages its website, store, or help pages are offered in

work_model.description: How most employees work, from its careers pages and job posts: remote-first, hybrid, or in an office

actively_hiring.description: Whether its careers page or job boards list open roles right now

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether the company's core product involves customers' health or financial records (health tracking, banking, insurance, lending). Taking card payments at checkout does not count

properties.name: Away
properties.description:
Away is a modern lifestyle brand creating thoughtful products designed to transform travel.

Since our launch in February 2016, we have become one of the fastest growing consumer brands in the world. We have sold millions of travel products, grown from a team of four to over 250, expanded shipping to nearly 40 countries, opened seven stores across two countries, and launched several new products and experiences that are inspiring more people to travel the world. And we know that’s just the beginning!

In just over three years, we have already been twice named one of Fast Company’s “World’s Most Innovative Companies,” one of TIME’s “50 Most Genius Companies,” one of LinkedIn's "Top Startups,"​ and a Forbes “Next Billion Dollar Startup.” We have also raised more than $156M in total equity funding to fuel our next phase of growth.

Today, we’re expanding into new travel product categories including apparel, wellness and lifestyle accessories as well as investing in the growth of physical retail in the US and abroad--with the plan to open 50 new stores in the next three years. Sound like something you want to be part of? We’re hiring!
